0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets, now 2-8 and 13th in the East, visit the New Orleans Pelicans, who are 4-6 and 11th in the West, in the 11th game of the Nets' season and the 10th for New Orleans. Brooklyn is 1-5 on the road and has lost its last two games, while New Orleans is 3-3 at home and has also dropped its last two. Egor Demin is out with a leg bruise and Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with a rest-related decision that will be made closer to game time, while Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis), Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Zion Williamson (rest) are all out for New Orleans. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season and split their two games in 2025-26, with the most recent meeting a 116-113 Nets loss in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
